# cpanel_mysql_users (Data Source)

Reads the complete cPanel MySQL or MariaDB user-name inventory through `Mysql::list_users`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_mysql_users" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (List of String) The complete database user names in sorted order.
